facts.value: The online Bachelor of Arts in liberal studies is one of Arizona State University's most flexible degrees. With only two core courses, the majority of your coursework is focused on electives of your choosing. You’ll be able to explore multiple interests while developing a multidisciplinary skill set relevant to a variety of careers.
